referenceFidelity.findings: The bridge is a new campus connector in the same timber/iron/pale architecture family, rather than a claim about real GitHub site adjacency.

construction.findings: Deck has broad individual boards, fixed iron posts, warm wood handrails, clear guards and a timber-supported pale cover. Symmetric rails terminate at structural posts; posts express their small exposed top caps. End openings remain usable.

readability.findings: Covered linear span and warm walking surface remain clear on the 390 px viewport. Thin rails are subordinate to the primary deck/roof silhouette.

motion.findings: Deliberately static environment architecture, no skeleton or authored clips.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked front/rear/oblique and phone after confirming the receiving warehouse and atrium interfaces. No blocking end panel or detached guard was observed; bridge top deck Y=.30 aligns with atrium landing at5.30 when placed atY5.
